training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch for both arms; no evaluation-based checkpoint selection

initialization: Exact refreshed 2024H2 seed-matched checkpoints previously trained through 2023 and selected on 2024H1; optimizer reset equally in both arms

auxiliary.objective: Population CRPS of sampled midpoint at two and five days, equally weighted over known horizons
auxiliary.gradient: Score-function estimate on real free-running discrete token paths, leave-one-out absolute-error baseline; no soft-token decoder and no future price context
auxiliary.illegal_paths: No path rejection or repair inside the loss; all finite generated midpoint draws enter the training risk. Evaluation retains the existing legal-path masks and reports coverage.
auxiliary.token_loss: Existing equally weighted five-day coarse/fine CE unchanged

selection.metric: Date-equal sampled-midpoint CRPS averaged over two/five-day horizons and three training seeds on a common cohort
selection.rule: Select lambda 0.05 only if its mean score is lower than matched CE continuation; otherwise lambda 0. No post-result coefficient search. Report endpoint, range and legal-path tradeoffs alongside the choice.
selection.limitation: 2024H1 already selected the warm-start checkpoints; this is reused development validation

evaluation.rule: Evaluate both predeclared arms after recording H1 selection; compare midpoint, endpoint, range and raw intervals. No 2025 outcome-based tuning.

unchanged: 3,720,448 parameter predictor architecture, history features, tokenizer, decoder, horizon CE weights, sampler and daily model; original calibration factors are not transferred to new checkpoints
interpretation: Bounded two-epoch continuation experiment, not from-scratch convergence or an untouched final test. Retain previous improvements and interpret local regressions alongside magnitude and consistency.
